meta.description: Discover in-depth FAQs about Atlas of Shenzhen

blocks.text: Since 2021, Dr Wei Wu and his team, alongside local historians, geographers, enterprenuers, has brought you stories, guides and recommendations from the most underestimated city- Shenzhen.
And while we continue to deliver the inspiring, wanderlust-inducing travel content that you’ve come to expect, we are also developing authentic and immersive small-group trips.
We encourage you to explore the video sections first, as it is easy to follow. If you are interested, please go to our opinions section to read more.
If you are interested in becoming a contributor, please let us know.
We collect local literature from different sources before we start writing or filming videos. We believe critical reading is the start of an authentic piece of a guidebook.
Then we consult local experts on their opinions of our work. This process is unique as most guidebooks do not engage with local experts, given the cost of editing.
